root_cause: The original overview disclosure moved initial five-stage and dashboard panels into a native details element, but later-mounted management-accounting and Foresight/scenario modules still used main as their insertion host. The resulting public entry showed a separate dense second dashboard immediately after the collapsed entrepreneur details.
fix: Keep the original overview, router, tenant and read-model unchanged. Move any pre-existing management and Foresight panels into the existing native details; after it mounts, render or replace later management-accounting, Foresight context, scenario studio and contextual candidate components inside the same details content. Preserve panel controls and event handlers rather than cloning data.
regression: tests/brain-portal-entrepreneur-late-panels-disclosure-20261105.test.mjs (four original-source owner contract tests) plus existing portal-v2/tests/entrepreneur-focus-mobile.test.mjs and original production DOM/mobile browser.
expected_benefit: One first screen centered on entrepreneur next action rather than immediate management-accounting/scenario technical inventories. Qualitative design ambition, not evidence of task-success performance.

evidence.actual_live_observation: Public portal-v2 entry showed section[data-entrepreneur-home], details[data-portal-overview-depth], then .ma-intel and .fsv-context as direct visible main children. Unauthenticated browser showed not logged in and many zero-measurement panels.
evidence.user_goal: mobile-first intuitive portal with premium Red Dot-caliber comprehensibility

prevention: All advanced/late renderers must target the existing overview disclosure if present; no parallel UI hierarchy. Preserve reachable details, keyboard semantics, scenario simulation caveats and native router. Require human task and accessibility evidence before award-readiness.
